Clinical source gate

What this page must establish

Confirm the exact device and active procedure, who performs it, the approved indications, candidacy, contraindications, recovery variability, limitations, alternatives, and care instructions. Do not publish mechanism or outcome language from the current draft until reviewed.

Page sections
